page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor, delivering 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz and includes 33 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core.

For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs based on the Turing architecture, offering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear contrast between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression tests. However, multi-core performance is strong, with high throughput in multi-threaded stress-ng and bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for small, cached blocks is highly efficient, though large-block read and write speeds align with average industry standards. Redis SET operations also demonstrate strong transaction throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dense consolidation of multiple GPUs and high vCPU counts on a single node, making it a viable alternative to deploying multiple smaller GPU instances. Given the lack of local storage and the moderate single-core speed, it is best suited for workloads that scale horizontally across many threads and leverage GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include machine learning inference, video transcoding, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput Redis caching layers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for multi-threaded workloads and parallel processing. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 372.0 GB of system memory. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs with a total of 64 GB of VRAM. The instance lacks local storage, relying entirely on network-attached options, and provides a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data indicates weak single-core performance but strong multi-core execution and high cached memory bandwidth. This hardware profile makes the instance highly suitable for parallelized workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and multi-threaded data processing.
